claims.text: Reviewers widely report that the product reduces the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, often within a few weeks.
Many reviewers praise the texture and application, noting it glides on smoothly, absorbs quickly, and leaves skin feeling moisturized.
Several reviewers mention liking the light, pleasant scent that is not overpowering.
Some reviewers note that results require patience and are not overnight, but are worth sticking with.
Multiple reviewers say they would recommend the product or plan to keep buying it, with some purchasing additional units.
